$comment: Private-target inventory for scripts/agnostic-check (issue #274, AGENTS rule 9). This file is DATA, not prose: the gate refuses a reference to any name/repo/path declared here. `privateRepos` covers the #273 clause — a public surface that links a repo declared `private` fails the gate. Visibility is verified OUT OF BAND (release / pre-merge, where the network is acceptable) and recorded here; the gate never probes, because a required check must not depend on a third party's uptime or rate limits (#132). `operatorPaths` are absolute local paths no reader can open; the generic documentation placeholder `/Users/…` (ellipsis) is NOT a match by construction. Add a target with its reason; remove one when the repo becomes public or the name stops being private.

privateNames.name: skills-studio
